verdict.rationale: Pipecat provides building blocks rather than a turnkey post-call extraction feature. Turn events let you collect user and assistant messages as transcripts. Flows functions take auto-derived typed parameters and can 'process data by interfacing with external systems and APIs', so a developer could capture entities or outcomes during the call and push them to their own endpoint. Missing for 10: a built-in post-call structured extraction or analysis feature (outcomes, dispositions), a first-party post-call webhook or API delivery mechanism, documentation of an end-of-call extraction workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
